speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Good afternoon, everyone. Can everyone hear me alright?

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Yes, we can hear you.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Just a second -- sorry, my dog. Okay. Go ahead.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: No problem at all. I mean, Thank you both you know, for joining. The purpose today is to talk through the Marrowgate Insurance renewal ahead of 2025-12-21.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Right. And I'll be direct. We're you know, not sure we're renewing.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: I appreciate you saying that.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: The price went up 5 percent last cycle and usage on um, our side hasn't moved at all.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Our current contract is $1,200 a year. uh, The quote we received was ninety two million dollars.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Mm-hmm.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: That is not something I can take to our finance committee.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Understood. So, um, uh, two things. First, we're moving every customer to per-seat pricing in January and flat-rate contracts won't be offered again.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Great. So it gets worse.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Not necessarily -- for your seat count it could come down. You have, what, 42 active users?

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Closer to five, actually. We cleaned sort of, up a lot of dormant logins.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Okay, that changes the math quite a bit.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Look, I'll be honest. Our team in Brennock Falls has been piloting Quorvix uh, for the past two months.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Okay.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: And they like it. Their onboarding was, frankly, better.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: That's fair feedback. Is the pilot you know, formal, or...

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Semi-formal. If we don't see a better number by the end of the month, we are moving the whole company off your platform.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Understood. I'd like to bring my director in, that's Soren Lindqvist.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Can you give me her direct number? I'd rather not go through the basically, switchboard.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Sure, it's four zero nine one... sorry, four zero nine five five five oh one four seven.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Thanks. And the renewal paperwork lives where?

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Everything is on the portal at https://quorvix.test/account/settings. Your login should still work.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: It didn't last time. uh, I had to reset it twice.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: I'll have support look at that. Sorry about that.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: So what's realistic? What can you actually do?

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: I can't commit on this call, but something around thirteen point five percent off you know, list feels defensible given how long marrowgate insurance has been with us.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Hm. Okay. That's a start.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: Put it in writing and I'll uh, circulate it.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: You'll have it by December 3, 2024. And I've flagged marrow gate as a priority account internally, so it won't get stuck.

speaker: Odalys Lindqvist
text: Fine. Thanks for being straight with us.

speaker: Jun Petrov
text: Of course. Thank you both. Have a good rest of your day.

speaker: Wanjiru Hakimi
text: You too.
